historical_research_leads.why_it_matters: The 2004 Lozhki thread says later Matrix screen-text decoding used help from matrixexplained.com forum members.
An old forum participant posted it as material for people trying to read Matrix screen text.
Posted in the same 2004 Matrix screen-text archaeology thread.

research_conclusions: The Heathrow headline is very strongly corroborated.
The Heathrow body is only partially recoverable from public transcriptions; column 2 has the strongest surviving reconstruction.
An-Nahar is strongly identified, but no reliable transcription of its 1999 Arabic body was found.
The first East-Asian-language result remains textually unresolved.
The final manhunt headline is strongly supported, but the paper name is disputed between 'Press Courier' and 'The Courier Press'.
No clearly better public 1999 still than the user's own 1080p Blu-ray frames was found in this pass.
